title: Add your first recurring payment
description: Set up a payment schedule and add the first payment. No integration needed.
workspace_help: A ledger is a workspace for payments, for example your household. Choose one you own or create a new one.
category_help: A category groups repeated payments for the same bill, such as internet. A group keeps related categories together.
code_help: Leave this empty to generate an available four-letter code. Once created, the code cannot be changed.
schedule_help: Oblidog creates future obligations on this schedule. You can enter amounts yourself; no integration is required. Due dates move to the preceding business day when needed.
unknown_amount: You can leave the amount empty and fill it in when you receive the bill.
ready: I confirm the amount and due date. This payment is ready to pay.
ready_help: Ready to pay means the details are confirmed. It does not mark the payment as paid.
incomplete_help: Without confirmation, this payment stays incomplete. Fill in or confirm its details later.
commit_notice: The group (if new), category, schedule and first payment will be saved together. Later amounts can be estimated from history and still need confirmation.
saved_notice: Completed steps are saved to your account. You can finish later. Starting over keeps any workspace already created.
preview_notice: Demo preview: this guide does not save payments or progress to the shared account. Closing it resets the preview.
done: Your first payment is set up
created: Your schedule and first payment are saved. You can now view and manage the payment.
preview_done: Preview complete. In your own installation, the schedule and first payment would now be saved. No demo data was changed.
integration_optional: Integrations can fill in bill details later. You can keep using Oblidog manually without one.
first_date: First scheduled date: {{date}}. The due date follows the business calendar.
